models.name: v-model
models.description:
The value for the input.
If the prop is not set undefined will be used.

props.name: id
props.description:
The id for the input id attribute.
The id for the label for attribute.
If the prop is not set a random value will be generated.

props.name: softLimit
props.description:
The number of characters for when the "characters left" warning should be shown.
A value of 100 means that when 100 or less characters is left the warning is shown.
If softLimit is used, then maxlength is required.
If the prop is not set undefined will be used, which means that no warning will be shown.

props.name: maxlength
props.description:
The maximum amount of characters permitted in the textarea.
If the prop is not set undefined will be used, which means unlimited.

props.name: charactersLeftWarning
props.description:
The string that should be shown in the "characters left" warning.
Must contain the word %charactersLeft% which is used to interpolate the number of characters left into the warning string.
If the prop is not set "Antal tecken kvar: %charactersLeft%" will be used.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specifies that the component should be disabled, i.e. unusable.

props.name: resizable
props.description: Enabling vertical resizing of the textarea

props.name: autoResize
props.description: Automatically adjust the textarea height to fit its content.

props.name: maxRows
props.description:
Maximum number of visible rows when `autoResize` is enabled.
When the content exceeds this height the textarea will scroll.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Optional slot for description. See {@link FLabel} for details.

bindings.name: description-class
bindings.description: CSS classes for primary description content.

slots.name: error-message
slots.description: Slot for displaying single or several error messages.

bindings.name: hasError
bindings.description: Set to true when a validation error is present

bindings.name: validationMessage
bindings.description: Descriptive validation error message for current error
